seoTitle: How to Use the Form Calculation Widget in Jotform
metaDescription: Set up Jotform's Form Calculation widget to automate totals, averages, and discounts on your forms using mapped fields and math operators.
intro: Manually calculating totals from form responses is slow and error-prone, especially for orders, invoices, or scored quizzes. Jotform's Form Calculation widget lets you map input fields to a formula so results appear automatically. This guide covers how to add the widget, map your fields, and configure the math so your form does the work for you.

steps.heading: Open the Widgets tab in Form Builder
steps.body: In your form project, go to the Form Elements panel and locate the Widgets section where Form Calculation lives.

steps.heading: Add the Form Calculation widget
steps.body: Drag the widget onto your form, then open the formula editor using the wand tool icon.

steps.heading: Map your input fields
steps.body: Click Add Field to bring the relevant form elements — like price or quantity fields — into your formula.

steps.heading: Build your formula
steps.body: Use the operations keypad and math functions to combine fields into totals, averages, or discount calculations.

steps.heading: Set number vs text formatting
steps.body: Toggle each mapped field's data indicator between numerical and text formats so the calculation reads values correctly.

steps.heading: Configure decimal precision
steps.body: Adjust the calculation properties to control how the final result is rounded and displayed.

faq.question: Can I use the calculation widget for quiz scoring?
faq.answer: Yes, it's commonly used by quiz creators to tally scores automatically based on selected answers, alongside totals for orders and invoices.

faq.question: What happens if a mapped field is left blank?
faq.answer: Blank or improperly formatted fields can throw off the calculation, so it's important to set the correct data indicator (number vs text) for every mapped field.

faq.question: Can I calculate discounts, not just totals?
faq.answer: Yes, the widget supports building custom formulas, so you can subtract a discount percentage or flat amount as part of the calculation.

faq.question: Does this widget update in real time as users fill the form?
faq.answer: Yes, the calculation is designed to update live as respondents enter values into the mapped fields.
